batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b B Lee

batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b MF Maharoof

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c V Sehwag b PJ Sangwan

balls.text: high full toss, around offstump, Nehra gets it away towards cover point for a single
fast yorker outside off, 133kmh, squeezed out towards point for a single
full and wide, Sangwan carves it towards teh sweeper on the off side boundary
Karthik is gone, it was a length ball, Karthik was looking to get under it and play over the cover, hits the bottom of the bat and flies towards long-on, who takes a simple catch
slower ball from Irfan, 107kmh, Sangwan swings at it and it sails towards deep extra cover for a single
full outside off, Karthik punches it towards cover for a single
fired into the blockhole, 139kmh, Karthik can only dig it out towards square for a single
overpitched on offstump, driven firmly toward cover for a single to get off the strike and the mark
another short ball, fast and outside off, has Sangwan fishing for it outside off
the slow bouncer has been Lee's favourite delivery today, this one was 123kmh, Karthik was looking to pull, had to delay his shot, he adjusts well to get it away to midwicket
no hat-trick for Lee, Karthik shows the full face of the bat as he defends back down the pitch
Nelson and Lee strike again, Lee on a hat-trick, short and not particularly wide, sliced to the waiting fielder at third man, can Delhi at least play out their overs?
Delhi lose another wicket, that was short and just outside off, Vettori goes for the pull, top-edges it to mid-off, David Shepherd would have been hopping before this delivery
short and wide, Karthik clouts it powerfully off the backfoot, but Brett Lee is there at deep point to do the fielding
length ball, was shaping away from the left-hander, Vettori chops it towards cover to get off the mark
overpitched on legstump, squeezed out towards long-on for a single
this was much fuller, outside off, Karthik lofted that inside-out over extra cover, was in teh air a long time but landed safely out of reach of the fielder
Irfan starts with abouncer on legstump, Karthik gets inside the line and paddle-pulls it past the keeper

stunning over from Lee, knocks out Maharoof's middle stump, a wicket-maiden at this stage is priceless, it was a length ball, Maharoof, as he has all over, was looking to give himself room to swing his arms, he misses Lee hits the stumps to end Maharoof's misery
can Lee send down a maiden, Maharoof again moving towards leg, Lee pushes it wide outside off and the batsman can't reach it
great over so far, Maharoof was giving himself room, so Lee sends it fast and full outside off, Maharoof bends his knees and swings at it but doesn't connect
yet another bouncer, this was 126kmh, Maharoof saw it and wanted to jab it over the keeper's head, but he doesn't get bat on ball again
another bouncer, this one is quick, 141 kmh, Maharoof had to get ouot of the way quickly
starts with a slow bouncer, Maharoof backs away and tries to slap it but doesn't connect
ends with a length ball on the pads, Maharoof mistimes a drive down to long-on, the batsmen saunter through for a single
that was well outside off, Maharoof threads it between the covers to get off the mark

there's the breakthrough, Manhas is gone, that was a full ball on middle, Manhas looked to swing it over to deep midwicket but didn't get the elevation he wanted and finds the midwicket fielder in the circle
wristily played off the front foot behind square leg, that will be the 50 partnership
very short and down the leg side, swung away to deep backward square leg, not enough power on that to take it for four
slightly overpitched, on middle and leg, Manhas was looking to swat that to midwicket, bottom edges it on his body and the ball rolls to the off side

superb fielding from Pomersbach at deep midwicket, the ball pitched on middle stump, Karthik was onto his back foot in a flash, gets the front leg out of the way and swipes to midwicket, Pomersbacj had to move quickly to his left to stop that one
an attempted pull trickles down the pitch after hitting the bottom of the bat
on the pads, and that's whipped away towards midwicket
length ball pitching on off, Manhas moves towards the leg side, and hammers it inside-out over a jumping extra cover
and that's a wide down the leg side
pushed past a diving bowler towards long-on, the fielder had to run in a long way from the deep so that will be two
given some air, but that was wide and outside off, crunched through the covers, stopped by the sweeper

full ball is punched wide of long-on, wide enough to give the batsmen time to get two, Karthik was racing through for the second which meant the fielder had to throw to the wicketkeeper if there was to be any chance of a run-out, 14 off the over
played inside-out towards extra cover by Manhas
again there's a shout  of 'catch' as a top edge flies towards a diving Powar at backward point, Lee has to do the fielding at the boundary
cracked off the backfoot, towards cover and they get a quick single
nudged towards square leg for a single
Yuvraj starts with a short hit-me delivery, Karthik gets onto his backfoot and clobbers it over midwicket for the first six of the innings
fuller and on middle, played down towards long-off for a single
short and wide, slapped to Powar at backward point
pushed towards cover this time, looking for a quick single but decide against it
'Catch' is the cry as there's a top edge as the batsman cuts but it lands short of third man who is in the circle
full and on middle and leg, pushed back to the bowler
poor ball to start, very short and on leg, Chawla gets away with it as it is swung to long leg for just a single
short of a length, a bit of width for Manhas, he throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge through to third man for a single
a touch wide outside off, opens the face and bunts it towards point for a single
fullish on offstump, played with soft hands towards cover, rush through for a single, a direct hit from Chawla gives away an extra run
fuller and on middle and leg, dug out inside out towards extra cover, another dot ball
back of a length outside off, Karthik opened the face to guide it to third man but doesn't connect
shortish and on middle stump, turned to midwicket
flighted again, Manhas gets forward and drives it to long-on
outside off this time, Manhas goes for the cut and misses
closer to the stumps but still too wide down the leg side
way down the leg side, that's a poor ball
Manhas looks to sweep from outside off, misses the ball and is nearly stumped by Sangakkara, just about makes his ground in time
played with soft hands toward Brett Lee at long-on, batsmen zip through for a couple
lovely flight from Powar, Manhas though responds with a delicate paddle sweep that runs way donw past short fine leg
given some air, overpitched on leg, turned towards the leg side
end of an accurate over from Sreesanth, length ball in the corridor, Manhas defends off the front foot, and that's the strategic time-out
back of the hand slower ball, 92kmh, probably too slow, giving the batsmen time to adjust, turned towards mid-on
lovely delivery from Sreesanth, the outswinger that made him famous beats Karthik, who was feeling for it outside off
a bit of width for Karthik to work with, he opens the face and pushes the ball towards point, no run again
back of a length on middle, looks to defend off the back foot, the ball drops dead at the batsman's feet, wonder whether to go for the single before deciding against it

Sreesanth gets another big wicket, a better ball than the one that got de Villiers, length ball on off, Dilshan wanted to chip it over mid-on, Yuvraj's  the fielder there and he latches on to it over his head
a lot of confusion in the calling after Manhas turned it to midwicket after waiting for the ball to turn, Dilshan was well down the pitch before being forced to turn back
Powar is keeping things tight here, pitched up outside off, punched to long-on
closer to off this time, Dilshan tries to work it behind point but finds the fielder
overpitched and wide outside off, slapped towards backward point
length ball, pushed towards the cover, batsmen sprint through a single
nicely flighted, defended back down the pitch off the front foot

short and wide from Sreesanth, chopped into the ground and over point by Manhas, Lee raced around to cut that off at the boundary, the sweeper Chawla was rushing in from the other side and nearly collided with Lee, just jumping over a sliding Lee at the last instant
very good from Sreesanth, bowling from a bit wide of the crease and angling it in, pitched on a length outside off and was heading for middle, Manhas prods it towards the covers
a slow bouncer from Sreesanth, 127kmh, just outside off, this time Manahs shows us his backfoot defence
Mithun Manhas defends his first ball cautiously off the front foot

Sreesanth strikes, not the greatest of deliveries but he won't be complaining, that was short and sat up to be hit, de Villiers could have hit it anywhere on the leg side, he manages to pick out the man at mid-on with a powerful pull though, and Delhi are in a bit of trouble here
good start to this Sreesanth over, length ball angling into leg stump, Dilshan pushes it towards mid-on
turned away to square leg for a single to end the over
down the leg side, de Villiers looks to sweep, doesn't quite get hold of it, gets it away fine down the leg though
another couple to midwicket for de Villiers, good running from the batsmen

lovely shot from de Villiers, that was flighted and overpitched, de Villiers chipped it to midwicket, Lee has some ground to cover before fielding, he rifles the throw in that hit de Villiers after he makes his ground
dabbed towards backward point by Dilshan for a single
flighted, didn't turn  too much, Dilshan was backing away to cut but missed, the ball nearly hit offstump
a closer lbw call this time, pitching on a length, just outside off, de Villiers was looking to defend on the front foot but was rapped on the pads
very wide outside off, and that's another free run
that was better from Sreesanth, jagged back sharply after pitching just outside off, hit de Villiers high on the pads, a bit of an appeal from Sreesanth but that was going over
well this is turning out to be a poor over so far, on a length, on middle and leg, de Villiers whips it gracefully off his pads for four to square leg, 1000th boundary of the IPL
shortish and again a bit of width, Dilshan reaches out and guides it towards third man, Lee collects cleanly this time
short and very wide, Dilshan chases it but doesn't reach it
shoddy work from Lee at third man, slapped down towards him by Dilshan, and that should only have been a single, Lee makes a mess of it in the deep, Sreesanth doesn't need this
starts with a back of length ball, Dilshan goes for his favourite pull again, but is beaten by the bounce
de Villiers defends that one to the off side off the back foot, and that's another fine over for Punjab
outside leg this time, Dilshan sweeps, hits the pads again and rolls towards backward square leg
similar ball, on middle and leg, again Dilshan punches it back to the bowler
shortens his length a bit, pitching on middle, defended back down the pitch
that was also flighted on legstump, Dilshan was looking to sweep, it hit his pads and ran away fine for four
tossed up, on a length, bounced a bit more than Dilshan thought, his cut fails to connect with the ball
that ends another good over for Punjab, the last ball was nice and tight around offstump, de Villiers defends towards the off side
slightly shorter, and a bit wider, de Villiers carves it through point, Brett Le has work to do on the boundary
overpitched outside off, AB de Villiers get forward and defends it studiously towards cover

superb throw and that's the end of Gambhir, the batsman chopped that towards deep backward point, and rushed back for the second, Wilkin Mota latches onto the ball and fires it in right over the stumps, Sangakkara collects and breaks the stumps, that's another massive wicket for Punjab
pitched up again by Irfan, Gambhir moved towards leg and tickled it towards short third man where Pomersbach puts in a diving stop to deny the run
again Irfan gets some away movement, Gambhir wanted to play that behind point but his waft doesn't connect with the ball
another fast bowler, Dilshan thinks of pulling but decides not to go for the shot, good over from Lee that
another quick bouncer, 144 kmh, Dilshan loves the pull and he goes for it first ball, hits him on the body as it rolls behind the stumps

Lee strikes, the short ball works this time, it was quick and aimed at Sehwag's ribs, not his favourite area, Sehwag tries to play it towards backward square leg but gets a faint edge through to the keeper
similar length but closer to the stumps, Sehwag bunts it towards mid-off off the back foot
length ball outside off, Sehwag cracks it through the covers for a boundary, raises his front leg to balance himself as he plays that stroke
another slower ball, much fuller this time, 107kmh, didn't get above ankle height, down the leg side though
this time Lee sends down a slower bouncer, 123kmh, Sehwag waits for it and lashes it hard towards cover, placement was poor, so there's no run for the taking
Lee will have to re-bowl that one, that was way down the leg side
Gambhir was again down the track, and moving towards leg, he looked to cut that towards point, gets a bottom edge which takes the ball towards fine leg where Brett Lee does the fielding
a lot fuller and on the pads, Sehwag looks to mow it towards midwicket, gets an inside edge onto his pads
slow bouncer from Irfan, 122kmh, that was really short, Sehwag saw it early and ducked out of the way comfortably, again the ball nearly bounce again before reaching the keeper
nice delivery, in the channel outside off, it was a length ball, Gambhir waits on the back foot and hacks it towards point
back of a length on the pads, Gamhir defends it to the leg side
Gambhir hurries down the pitch, but Irfan drops it a touch short, gets a bit of away swing, Gambhir flashes at it, gets thick outside edge which lands a few yards short of third man
Gambhir gets another quick single to retain the strike, it bounced a bit more than he expected, adjusted well to turn it to the leg side
pushes up his length, on the legstump, Sehwag tried to glance it to fine leg, is hit on the pads, and the balls dribbles behind square leg
Sehwag starts with a bang, short and wide, rocks back and crunches it through the covers for a boundary, Sehwag's never been one for the "get-the-eye-in" theory
back of a length ball on middle, nudged towards square leg by Gambhir who sets off for the single, Sehwag is late to react and would have been run out if there was a direct hit
slips in the bouncer, 142.1kmh, just outside off, has Gambhir fishing at it, doesn't get a nibble on it though, that nearly bounced twice before reaching the keeper
Brett Lee starts with a length ball on middle and leg, Gambhir tucks it towards square leg
and it's over, Sangakkara backs away and slaps it through the covers for a boundary, and Delhi go down, Punjab stay alive
great bit of fielding from Sangwan takes the match to the final over, it was short on legstump, the batsman swivelled and pulled it towards fine leg, Sangwan was quick across the turf to cut that off
full and on legstump, Irfan can't get that away but it thuds into his pads and dribbles towards backward point
swatted powerfully towards midwicket, the batsmen sprint through for a couple

Punjab fans will relish this one, Irfan rocks back and gets under a length ball on legstump, clouts it high over wide long-on, just clear the rope by a few yards, would have been caught if the boundaries weren't pulled in
oh Delhi fans won't like that, another one down leg
half-volley on legstump, Maharoof is lucky to get away with that one, Irfan can't put it away
yorker just outside legstump, hits the pads and runs away towards square leg
more poor bowling, wide down the leg side, can't afford that in these tight situations
that was awful from Sangwan, hard to criticise an 18-year-old, but that was a full toss on the pads, was asking to be hit out of the park, Irfan swings it over the square-leg boundary
this was a bit fuller, Irfan couldn't quite get under it, he slams it straight to the mid-on fielder
Shot! pressure reliever for Punjab, short and again in the corridor outside off, Irfan was down the pitch and he mows it over midwicket for a big six
low full toss, around the offstump, Sangakkara moves away and carves it towards point
yorker just outside off, dug out back towards the bowler
shortish and coming into Sangakkara, he stays on the back foot and tries to pound it over mid-off,  mistimed and he just about clears the fielder
oof that was close, full and just outside off, Sangakkara was looking for the off-drive, gets an inside-edge and the french cut gets Punjab a run
back of a length offcutter, bounces sharply over the stumps, Sangakkara had shuffled across to swings it toward fine leg, but he doesn't connect either
again a length ball on off, Irfan was onto the shot early, was in the air a bit but it lands safely before reaching long-on
this is fuller and a lot wider, Irfan was looking to scythe that through cover, but doesn't make contact
no flourishes from Bhatia, length ball on offstump, just the basics, defended by Irfan
fullish ball outside off, Sangakkara bent his kne and crashed that powerfully towards cover, Dilshan's dive keeps the batsmen to a single
superb over for Delhi, only two runs off it, Irfan's plays around a length ball on legstump, there's a muted appeal from Sangwan, but that was going down

Yuvraj is gone, Delhi are delighted, Sangwan won't be getting wickets with too many deliveries worse than that one, it was short and wide, asking to be hit, Yuvraj hit it but straight to Sehwag at backward point, Sehwag is ecstatic, a twist in the game
wonderful shot from Yuvraj, the length was fuller, a high backlift from Yuvraj as his straight drive just misses the non-striker's stumps, de Villiers has to dive at the boundary to keep it in
short and wide again, Yuvraj throws his bat at it but is beaten, no footwork in that shot from Yuvraj
short and very wide, slower ball as well, 104kmh, Yuvraj was charging down the pitch, he somehow manages to reach that ball, hits the bottom hand and goes to the keeper on the bounce
Sangwan starts with a good delivery, short of a length, about a foot outside off, Yuvraj wantedto guide it to third man, but ended up playing inside the line
slower ball to end the over, 89kmh, Sangakkara spotted it early, made room and crunched it over cover for a boundary
Yuvraj's bottom hand came off the bat as he tried to off-drive, the ball flie down to long-on for a single
wide outside off, Sangakkara chips it towards point, safely, Gambhir does the fielding on the boundary
good ball from Bhatia, it bounced a bit extra, Sangakkara was making room on the backfoot, but his attempted cut is beaten
on the middle and leg and Yuvraj works it to backward square leg
ooh, that was nearly a catch, the cover fielder threw himself full length to try get a hand on Yuvraj's lofted drive, can't reach it and Delhi get a couple
tapped towards short midwicket by Sangakkara
effortless by Yuvraj, just chipped over the bowler's head, long-on does the fielding
another dot ball, Yuvraj was a few paces dwon the pitch but it was a shorter ball, and he can only push it to mid-off
pushed through by Vettori, defended back down the pitch off the front foot
flighted by Vettori, lovely shot from Yuvraj, waited on the backfoot and played it late to get the placement perfectly, wide of backward point for four
wide ball, Sangakkara slaps it towards deep point for a single
Sangakkara pushes it to cover, straight to the fielder
more poor fielding from Delhi, this time its Nehra, Sangakkara lifts it wide of long-ogg whre Nehra should have stopped the ball, lets it through for a boundary
'Catch it' shout Delhi's fielders as Yuvraj lofts the ball towards long-off, lands a couple of yards short of the boundary
again Dilshan pushes it wide, Yuvraj reaches across and pushes it towards cover
Dilshan starts his spell with a length ball wide outside off, punched down to long-off
tossed up by Vettori, fullish ball, Sangakkara waits on the backfoot and turns it to midwicket
width for Yuvraj to work with, he rocks back and crashes it towards backward point
length ball on middle, played firmly to mid-on by Yuvraj
this time Sangakkara nudges it towards square leg for a single
Sangakkara tries sweep an outside-off ball but the ball bounce more than he though and he's beaten
Vettori is taken for a single down to long-on, that was taken from well outside off
overpitched on middle and leg, defended watchfully towards mid-on, that ends a good over for Punjab
Gambhir horror day continues, it was a length ball which was  bit wide, Sangakkara carves it towards deep point, Gambhir makes a mess of a routine stop at the boundary
Sangakkara gets a streaky boundary, he was backing away to slap it through the covers, gets a thick edge past the keeper for a boundary
Bhatia keeps it simple, wicket-to-wicket stuff, Sangakkara defends back down the pitch
that was a short ball, Yuvraj was early into his shot as he opened the face to play towards backward point
innocuous delivery, on a length around off, 106kmh, Yuvraj defends with exaggerated caution
starts off with a poor ball, way down the leg side
Sangakkara  stays on the backfoot this time and looks to cut, but the ball bounces more than he expected and he's beaten, superb over to start from Vettori
Sangakkara sashays down the pitch but gain he can't get it away, only as far as the bowler
Sangakkara gets a big stride in and defends the ball back towards the bowler
this one was on the pads, Sangakkara can only play it towards square leg
a touch shorter from Vettori, Yuvraj rocks onto the back foot and punches it down the ground for a single
flights his first ball, turns into Yuvraj, who turns it towards midwicket
that was a pretty poor over from Sangwan, and he's finally punished off the final delivery, more hit-me short-and-wide deliveries, Sangakkara gets on to of that and hammers it to the point boundary
shorter from Sangwan, and some width as well, Sangakkara chips it towards third man to get a couple
full and on offstump, defended by Sangakkara back down the pitch

Sangwan gives Yuvraj a second chance to get his placement right, this was even wider than the previous ball, placement was decent but Yuvraj couldn't time this one, sweeper on the boundary does the fielding
that was a loose delivery, short and very wide, Yuvraj wanted to hammer that through covers, connect well, but the placement is poor
starts with a full ball on middle and off, Yuvraj plays it cautiously towards mid-on
short ball, and about a foot outside off, Sangakkara bends his knees to get under it and guides it wide of third man
a bit of width for Sangakkara, he opens the face and jabs it towards backward point
fuller and on the pads, Sangakkara plays it inside-out towards cover, the runs aren't coming easy for Punjab
banged in short, Sangakkara ducks and lets it go
short ball, off-stump line, Sangakkara leans back to make some room, and dabs it to backward point, 'No' he calls immediately
fullish on middle and off, turned towards mid-on for a single by Yuvraj
Nehra ends a sensational spell with another dot ball, same formula from him, short of length targetting offstump, Sangakkara tap it towards mid-off
back to probing around the offstump, Sangakkara is content to play that back to the bowler
overpitched and a bit of width this time, Sangakkara slices it towards deep backward point for a couple
lovely line from Nehra, just outside off stump, the length pushed Sangakkara to the backfoot and he can only defend that one back down the pitch
back of a length on the stumps, Sangakkara gets on the backfoot and pats it to cover
Nehra starts off with a dot ball, looked to defend on the backfoot but is beaten
pushes it wider this time, back of a length again, Sangakkara watches that through to the keeper
doesn't get punished, length was a bit fuller, Sangakkara backed away and swung hard at the ball, gets a thick edge which has the ball flying to third man
Maharoof's no-ball problem resurfaces to end a ten-ball streak without a run, it was left alone by Sangakkra outside off, free-hit for him now
similar length, this time on middle stump, Sangakkara wanted to defend that one, but gets an edge onto his body and the ball rolls towards point
slow, shortish ball on the pads, Sangakkara defends it off the backfoot towards square leg, nine consecutive dot balls

AB de Villiers shows Gambhir how slip catching is done, Pomersbach departs, the ball was angling across the batsman, gets an edge, de Villiers was at a wid-ish first slip, he ad to dive full length to his left and a bit to his back to latch on to that, Delhi aren't going to go down without a fight
that was onto Pomersbach quicker than he expected, short of length ball on middle and leg, Pomersbach gets behind the line and defends awkwardly
wicket-maiden from Nehra, should have had two wickets in that over though, maintained that immaculate line on the final ball as well, and Yuvraj lets that go by playing inside the line
similar ball, this time Yuvraj moves across to get behind the line and defend back to the bowler
dropped by Gambhir, that is a big miss, length ball again in the corridor, Yuvraj decided to play off the back foot, edged it at catchable height to first slip where Gambhir grasses a sitter
this team it's on offstump, and full, dug out towards the covers by Yuvraj
beautiful ball first up for Yuvraj, just outside off, shortish, Yuvraj was in two minds whether to defend that to leave it, finally decided to not offer a shot
more excitement, Sohal's legstump takes a walk after he shuffles across too much, he was looking to glance that off his thigh pad but missed the ball, which crashed into legstump
Punjab don't waste the free-hit this time, it was full and on the apds, Pomersbach whacks it away over wide long-on for a boundary, that ends an eventful, and interminable, over
another no-ball, a mix of tripe and terrific deliveries this over from Maharoof, outside off and let through to the keeper
great ball from Maharoof, bangs in the bouncer, Pomersbach gets behind the line and looks to defend, rise more than he expected and hits him on the fingers
length ball outside offstump, Pomersbach was down the track and threw his bat at it, gets a thick outside edge which sails one-bounce over the third man boundary
it's the slower ball from Maharoof this time, defended off the front foot towards cover
manages to keep his foot behind the line this time, sends down a good bouncer as well, which Sohal is unable to get away
yet another no-ball, Pomersbach backed away and swung it inside-out, he gets an edge, and the catch is taken at cover, doesn't matter and there's another free-hit to follow
similar length from Maharoof, poked away towards point, that was a no-ball as well, <>free-hit coming up
and he gets a wicket first ball! back of a length ball angling across Katich, who feels for it outside offstump, nicks it through to the keeper
similar length but a touch wider, Katich plays it with soft hands towards mid-on and the batsmen scurry through for a single
some swing on offer for Nehra, swung out before pitching on a length just outside offstump, defended off the backfoot by Katich
back of a length, on leg stump, turned off his thigh pad towards short fine leg for a single
slips in the bouncer, 133.4kmh, he had to bend and gets underneath it
length ball on offstump, played back towards the bowler
Nehra keeps it around offstump, defended towards the covers
Sangwan again errs by feeding Katich's cut shot, short and wide yet again, and this time Katich clobbers that over third man for six
fuller length outside off, Katich gets forward and taps it to mid off, straight to the fielder
short and a touch wide, Katich dispatches that to the point boundary, poor over from Sangwan so far
back of a length, Katich edges it onto his midriff and the ball rolls towards backward point, Dilshan was onto in  a flash and was looking to get the non-striker run-out, four overthrows
that was shorter and wider, 121kmh, Katich reaches across to cut but only manages to hit it hard into the ground, that would have been a wide if he let it go
Sangwan starts with a hit-me ball, short and wide, Katich slaps it over backward point for a boundary
that was fractionally outside leg, Sohal was way across the stumps to tickle it to fine leg but he misses
Katich takes the bottom hand off the bat as he chops that outside-offstump ball towards point
Sohal gets Punjab off the mark by guiding the ball with the angle towards third man for a single
tests Sohal with the bouncer this time, 130kmh, that was on a middle-stump line, Sohal manages to evade it by ducking
length ball on middle, Sohal gets behind the line ot defend, gets an outside edge towards point
Nehra gets some inward movement straightaway, hurtles into Sohal's thigh pad
